purpose: Wave-4 Desert + Morytania permanent skilling unlocks still missing as first-class rows in data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json. Covers Citharede illuminated god books, cactus Farming patches, Agility Pyramid, Nardah Elidinis Statuette, Crocodile Tears heat immunity, Menaphos Imperial acadia WC, Sceptre of the gods, enchanted water tiara; Nature Grotto altar of nature, Mort Myre fungi bloom, Burgh de Rott skilling hub, Temple Trekking permanent reward package, Ectofuntus slime pit, Barrows chest diary skilling utility, ouroboros pouch, games necklace Burgh teleport, Canifis–Mort'ton trapdoor shortcut, and ghast familiar.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed absent from regional-skilling-unlocks.json for all 18 target ids. Related present rows NOT re-emitted: desert:menaphos-skilling-hub, desert:menaphos-reputation-vip, desert:pyramid-plunder-black-ibis, desert:desert-amulet / desert:area-tasks-desert-amulet, morytania:ectofuntus-prayer-worship, morytania:ectofuntus-first-age-outfit, morytania:port-phasmatys-skilling-hub, morytania:temple-trekking-skilling-outfits, morytania:temple-trekking-construction-dependency, morytania:morytania-legs-1 through legs-4, morytania:canifis-farming-and-slayer-hub.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks that change Prayer QoL, desert heat logistics, Farming patches, WC hubs, Pyramid Plunder tool economy, travel shortcuts, and ghast/fungus loops.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, and effects only.

activity_additions.name: Citharede Abbey illuminated god books
activity_additions.location: Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede, east of Al Kharid (past desert strykewyrms)
requirements: One Piercing Note completed for book-making table access
60 Crafting and 60 Prayer
Completed god book (Horror from the Deep damaged book + all four matching pages)
Enough prayer points for four illumination steps (each step drains 200 prayer; abbey altar recharges)
unlocks: Illuminated god books (Law, War, Balance, Wisdom, Chaos, Ancient) via book-making table south-east of abbey entrance
First-time illumination per book: 10,000 Crafting XP and 10,000 Prayer XP (reward XP; not boosted by XP outfits)
Illuminated pocket-slot books with same combat passive effects as base books, rechargeable with matching god pages (45 minutes per page, max 24 hours / 32 pages)
POH bookcase reclaim of illuminated books for 120,000 coins if lost
Cosmetic illuminated god-book overrides after each completion (full set unlocks extra recolours)
activity_additions.notes: Desert infrastructure for the god-book upgrade path — base books are Horror from the Deep (Fremennik / lighthouse). Original completed book is preserved; illumination creates a separate illuminated copy with zero charges. Steps in order: copy text → embellish initial capitals → add colour → add gold leaf. Pair with desert heat logistics and Al Kharid access, not as a second claim on Horror from the Deep.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert for the abbey table. God-book page supply and Horror from the Deep remain multi-region pressure, not Desert-only.

activity_additions.name: Desert cactus Farming patches
activity_additions.location: Al Kharid, Menaphos Imperial, Het's Oasis (Anachronia cactus is Anachronia — not claimed here)
requirements: 55 Farming for cactus seeds (higher seeds: prickly pear 76, potato cactus 86, dragonfruit 95, golden dragonfruit 116)
Menaphos Imperial cactus: mine sandstone boulder and give Zahra 12 unnoted acadia logs to build (~10 minutes)
Hard Desert achievements for disease-free + double spines / potato cactus on Al Kharid, Menaphos, and Het's Oasis patches
unlocks: Three Desert cactus patches (Al Kharid gardener Ayesha; Menaphos Imperial gardener Zahra; Het's Oasis gardener Grouch)
Cactus spines, potato cactus, dragonfruit, and related produce for Herblore and secondary uses
Hard Desert diary: disease-free cactus patches and double cactus spines / potato cactus harvest yields on the three Desert patches
Direct plant into patch (no plant pot); no watering required; produce regrows every 20 minutes after full growth
activity_additions.notes: Anachronia northern totem cactus is separate region geography — do not dual-claim. Menaphos patch is the Imperial-district build, not VIP. Complements desert:garden-of-kharid-rewards and desert:menaphos-skilling-hub without re-emitting them.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert for Al Kharid / Menaphos / Het's Oasis patches. Anachronia patch is Anachronia pressure only.

activity_additions.name: Agility Pyramid (Jaleustrophos)
activity_additions.category: Agility course and Menaphos reputation supply
activity_additions.location: Between Sophanem and Nardah, Kharidian Desert
requirements: 30 Agility
Desert heat mitigation until Crocodile Tears heat immunity (waterskins, enchanted water tiara, or robes)
unlocks: Agility course ending in a pyramid top artefact per successful top claim + doorway exit
Simon Templeton exchange: 1,000 coins and 200 Menaphos reputation per pyramid top (10,000 coins per top with elite Desert achievements)
1,500 Agility XP per clean full lap (700 XP at doorway) as course infrastructure
Fast access via Pharaoh's sceptre / Sceptre of the gods Jaleustrophos teleport or Desert amulet 2+ Nardah run
activity_additions.notes: Dual-purpose Desert Agility training and Menaphos reputation farm via Simon. Pets and familiars banned on the pyramid. Pyramid tops are not stackable and weigh 11 kg — sell before next ascent. Complements desert:menaphos-reputation-vip without re-emitting VIP tiers.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert Agility infrastructure. Elite diary coin boost is Desert achievements ownership, not a second region.

activity_additions.name: Nardah Elidinis Statuette
activity_additions.category: permanent Prayer and life restore shrine
activity_additions.location: Nardah shrine, slightly north of the city fountain
requirements: Spirits of the Elid completed to restore the Elidinis Statuette
unlocks: Pray-at shrine fully restores prayer points and life points
Temporary +500 life points boost above maximum on pray
Local Nardah fountain for waterskin refills adjacent to the shrine loop
Practical mid-desert restore node for Agility Pyramid, Sophanem, and southern desert skilling
activity_additions.notes: Core Desert Prayer QoL after Spirits of the Elid. Not a bone-offering altar and not a substitute for Ectofuntus or gilded altars — pure restore + temporary LP boost. Pair with Desert amulet Nardah teleports for practical use.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert quest unlock. Resolve Spirits of the Elid via auto-quest overlay before treating as free restore.

activity_additions.name: Crocodile Tears desert heat immunity
activity_additions.location: Kharidian Desert (quest reward; immunity is account-wide in desert)
requirements: Crocodile Tears completed (Menaphos-era Crondis quest chain through Jack of Spades / Spirits of the Elid / Missing My Mummy / Dealing with Scabaras path)
Skill gates on the quest: 30 Agility, 72 Fishing, 73 Hunter, 47 Woodcutting (plus combat for Ukunduka)
unlocks: Permanent immunity to desert heat (re-log if heat still applies after quest complete)
Menaphos reputation gain increased to 150%
Relic of Crondis for a chosen Menaphos faction reputation dump
Access to Crondis tomb (Nekhakha, Crondis mask, first-visit Constitution XP)
Makes waterskins / enchanted water tiara obsolete for heat mitigation
activity_additions.notes: The permanent skilling logistics prize of the Crondis quest is heat immunity plus reputation multiplier — not the combat fight itself. Enchanted water tiara remains useful only before this quest. Do not invent XP/hour for post-immunity desert Mining/Hunter routes.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert quest. Skill gates remain even if Menaphos access is league-granted early.

activity_additions.name: Menaphos Imperial acadia Woodcutting
activity_additions.location: Menaphos Imperial district and VIP skilling area
requirements: 50 Woodcutting
Menaphos access (The Jack of Spades / Desert region access)
VIP acadia trees need overall Menaphos reputation tier 7
unlocks: Acadia trees at 80 WC XP per log; multiple logs per cut possible
5.6 Menaphos reputation per Imperial acadia chop
Eight Imperial district acadia trees plus four VIP trees (VIP depletes at half rate)
Imperial tier 8 permanent Woodcutting success boost (also applies inside VIP)
Acadia logs as Construction/Firemaking supply and cactus-patch build payment for Zahra
activity_additions.notes: First-class WC row for the Menaphos acadia loop already named inside desert:menaphos-skilling-hub — this is the checklist unlock for ironman WC + reputation. Do not paste 55k–92k/h community rate claims as planner guarantees. Het's Oasis and Uzer acadia stands are secondary Desert sites.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert / Menaphos. VIP trees still need overall reputation tier 7.

activity_additions.name: Sceptre of the gods
activity_additions.category: permanent Pyramid Plunder tool and desert teleport network
requirements: 91 Thieving and 75 Runecrafting to loot the engraved sarcophagus in room 8
Pyramid Plunder access (Icthlarin's Little Helper progress / Sophanem access)
unlocks: Untradeable sceptre with teleports: Jalsavrah (Pyramid Plunder), Jaleustrophos (Agility Pyramid), Jaldraocht (Azzanadra's pyramid), Jalkabir (Menaphos Golden Palace)
Charge caps: 10 base, 20 with medium Desert achievements, 60 with hard Desert achievements
While wielded in Pyramid Plunder: four extra high-value urns in rooms 7–8 and double black ibis outfit drop chance
Recharge with Pyramid Plunder artefacts at the guardian mummy (or jewelled diamond statuette used on sceptre); hard Desert doubles artefact charge values
Drop chance 1/480 from engraved sarcophagus with bad-luck mitigation down to 1/20 (2026 early-game rebalance rates; luck tiers improve slightly)
activity_additions.notes: Superior ironman sibling of the tradeable Pharaoh's sceptre. Complements desert:black-ibis-outfit without re-emitting black ibis set effects. Camouflage outfit no longer boosts sceptre chance (2026). Keep separate from combat wand claims — this is the desert teleport + Plunder QoL tool.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert acquisition and teleports. Diary charge caps require Desert Area Tasks ownership.

activity_additions.name: Enchanted water tiara
activity_additions.location: Player-crafted after Dealing with Scabaras (Desert quest)
requirements: Dealing with Scabaras completed
50 Runecrafting and 50 Magic (RC may be boosted; Assist System cannot create the tiara)
Water tiara + at least 3 water runes (1 charge per 3 water runes; up to 500,000 charges)
unlocks: Head-slot replacement for waterskins while worn — 1 charge consumed per desert heat drink trigger
Up to 500,000 stored charges for multi-hour desert Mining / Hunter / Agility without waterskin inventory
Prayer bonus 2 as minor side stat
Destroyed form returns water tiara + unused water runes to the floor
activity_additions.notes: Pre–Crocodile Tears desert logistics staple for granite/sandstone quarry, necrite Uzer, crimson skillchompas, and Agility Pyramid. Becomes obsolete after Crocodile Tears heat immunity. Only one enchanted water tiara may be owned; falling below 50 RC reverts it to a normal water tiara. Cannot be used on the wicked hood.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert craft path. After Crocodile Tears, prefer heat immunity over charging this tiara.

activity_additions.name: Nature Grotto altar of nature
activity_additions.category: Prayer altar and Nature Spirit infrastructure
activity_additions.location: Nature Grotto island, southern Mort Myre Swamp (bridge approach from the south)
requirements: Nature Spirit completed to restore the grotto and altar
unlocks: Altar of nature: restores prayer and boosts prayer points by +20 (one of three such altars with Monastery and Seers' headband 3 Seers' altar)
Bless silver sickles into silver sickle (b) on the altar for Bloom
Bless silvthril dust for related Myreque item paths
Empty druid pouch spawn beside the altar; nearby Summoning obelisk for pouch making
Temple Trekking total companion level 100+ unlocks swamp-gate shortcut toward the Nature Grotto
activity_additions.notes: Not the nature Runecrafting altar (Karamja). Core early Morytania Prayer + Bloom infrastructure. Complements morytania:mort-myre-fungi-bloom and Temple Trekking shortcuts without re-emitting ectofuntus rows.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania after Nature Spirit. Resolve quest auto-completion before treating as free +20 altar.

activity_additions.name: Mort Myre fungi Bloom harvest
activity_additions.category: Herblore supply and druid pouch fill activity
requirements: Nature Spirit for silver sickle (b) or later Ivandis flail / Sunspear bloom tools
Prayer points to cast Bloom (up to 60 prayer drained per cast; drain not tied to produce quantity)
Morytania legs 1+ worn for double fungi from easy diary
unlocks: Mort myre fungus from Bloom on dead logs for super energy secondary (52 Herblore) and druid pouch fill (1 harvest per fungus)
Easy Morytania legs worn: double fungi while casting Bloom
Druid pouch charges to make ghasts visible/attackable and protect food from rot
POF zygomite produce path as alternate fungus supply later
activity_additions.notes: Primary self-sufficient super energy secondary farm for ironmen in Morytania. Bloom also yields stems/pears/vine flowers for pouch filling. Pair with ouroboros pouch / ghast familiar so swamp logistics stop destroying stacks. Do not invent collect/hour rates.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania Nature Spirit gate for sickle. Legs double-fungi is diary ownership on top of the activity.

activity_additions.name: Burgh de Rott skilling hub
requirements: In Aid of the Myreque started/progressed for town access and repair content
Construction materials to repair bank (5 planks, 20 nails, 1 swamp paste) and general store / furnace as needed
unlocks: Repairable bank closest to Barrows, Shades of Mort'ton, Abandoned Mine, and Lair of Tarn Razorlor
Repairable furnace and Aurel's Supplies general store (raw thin snails for thorny snail pouches)
Dense big-net / harpoon shark fishing spots on the southern docks with nearby permanent fire for cooking
Temple Trekking noticeboard start and Myreque hideout cellar
Small Summoning obelisk outside the town gates
Games necklace / Drakan's medallion Burgh teleports as permanent travel on-ramps once unlocked
activity_additions.notes: Treat Burgh as the southern Morytania bank + shark + Temple Trekking hub, not only a quest town. Vyrewatch aggression near the furnace makes it a poor pure Smithing AFK site. Complements Barrows and Mort'ton loops.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania. Resolve In Aid of the Myreque via auto-quest before treating bank/furnace as free.

activity_additions.name: Temple Trekking permanent reward package
activity_additions.location: Burgh de Rott ↔ Paterdomus (Temple Trekking / Burgh de Rott Ramble)
requirements: In Aid of the Myreque for Temple Trekking
The Darkness of Hallowvale for Burgh de Rott Ramble reverse route
Companion level milestones for individual rewards (total levels 100 / 200 / 300 / 400 / 500; individual 99s)
unlocks: Constructor's outfit pieces and lumberjack outfit path (see existing outfits rows — this package is the remaining permanent reward ladder)
Ouroboros pouch at Jayene Kliyn level 99 (infinite druid pouch; toolbelt attach)
Canifis→Mort'ton trapdoor shortcut at Zachory Bragg level 99 (toggle on noticeboard)
Swamp-gate → Nature Grotto shortcut at total companion level 100+
Games necklace Burgh de Rott teleport at total companion level 500+ (with Darkness of Hallowvale)
Ghast familiar unlock at all companions level 99 (pouches bought 50k + 25 scrolls; cannot be player-crafted)
Rambler's backpack and walking stick cosmetic rewards at lower companion levels
Reward tokens (blue/yellow/red) for essence, bowstrings, stone spirits, herbs, sharks, seeds, and skill tomes
activity_additions.notes: Does not re-emit morytania:temple-trekking-skilling-outfits or construction-dependency pointer. This is the permanent account-state checklist ironmen use for ouroboros, shortcuts, Burgh necklace teleport, and ghast familiar. Complete Trekky (all companions 99) feeds Thoroughly A-Ghast elite diary via the familiar.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania minigame. Companion levels are account grind even if quests auto-complete.

activity_additions.name: Ectofuntus Pool of Slime (slime pit)
requirements: Access to Ectofuntus / Port Phasmatys (Ghosts Ahoy strongly recommended)
58 Agility for weathered wall shortcut between basement levels (optional QoL)
unlocks: Use slime on Pool of Slime to fill backpack with buckets of slime without bringing empty buckets
Morytania legs 2/3/4 operate teleports directly to the slime pit (5 / 10 / unlimited daily)
Weathered wall Agility shortcut shortening multi-level slime collection
Pairs with bone grinder and Ectofuntus worship for 4× Prayer XP and ecto-tokens
activity_additions.notes: Dedicated slime-supply row; worship activity remains morytania:ectofuntus-prayer-worship and First age outfit remains the ecto-token sink. Robin free slime + bonemeal conversion scales with legs 2/3/4 and lives on those diary rows. Filling speed was patched slightly faster (2024).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania. Legs teleports require diary ownership; pit itself is Phasmatys geography.

activity_additions.name: Barrows chest diary skilling utility
activity_additions.location: Barrows reward chest / mounds, southern Morytania
requirements: Hard Morytania achievements completed for legs 3 bank-from-chest and double runes
Barrows access (Priest in Peril / Morytania entry)
unlocks: Morytania legs 3 always: bank Barrows chest loot directly from the reward chest
Morytania legs 3 always: double runes from Barrows chests
Morytania legs 3 worn/area: prayer drain halved in the Barrows
Strange Old Man hard-set claim at the mounds as the diary reward NPC
Skilling-adjacent supply loop: runes + banked junk without leaving the chest
activity_additions.notes: Skilling/utility framing of hard diary Barrows rewards — not a combat guide for brothers or Rise of the Six. Combat drop tables and set effects stay in regional combat enrichment. Complements Burgh bank proximity and Drakan medallion travel without re-emitting legs equipment rows.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania diary ownership. Chest banking is account-state once hard tasks are claimed.

activity_additions.name: Ouroboros pouch
activity_additions.location: Temple Trekking noticeboard reward (Burgh de Rott / Paterdomus)
requirements: Temple Trekking access (In Aid of the Myreque)
Train Jayene Kliyn to level 99 and claim druidic reward on the noticeboard
unlocks: Infinite-charge druid pouch that auto-activates when a ghast approaches
Tool belt attach under the Slayer section — frees inventory forever
Stops ghast food-rot pressure without manual pouch fills during swamp, fungus, and Temple Trekking runs
activity_additions.notes: Highest-value Temple Trekking permanent tool after outfits for swamp Herblore logistics. Complements morytania:mort-myre-fungi-bloom. Does not replace the ghast familiar (separate all-companions-99 unlock).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania Temple Trekking grind. Jayene 99 is the gate even if outfits were already claimed from other companions.

activity_additions.name: Games necklace Burgh de Rott teleport
activity_additions.category: permanent travel unlock on enchanted jewellery
activity_additions.location: Burgh de Rott destination (necklace crafted anywhere)
requirements: The Darkness of Hallowvale completed
Temple Trekking companions combined total level 500+
Games necklace (Lvl-1 Enchant on sapphire necklace; 8 charges)
unlocks: Burgh de Rott option on games necklace rub / worn right-click teleports
Fast bank access for Barrows, Shades of Mort'ton, Abandoned Mine, and Temple Trekking starts
Complements Drakan's medallion without replacing it (medallion is separate quest reward)
activity_additions.notes: The permanent Morytania destination unlock on an otherwise multi-region necklace. Other necklace destinations (Troll Invasion, Barbarian Outpost, Gamers' Grotto, Corporeal Beast, Tears of Guthix, Agoroth) are not Morytania claims. Wiki patch notes (2021) still list Darkness of Hallowvale; companion total 500 remains the Temple Trekking reward gate for the Burgh option.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania for destination unlock + companion total 500. Necklace craft is global Magic/Crafting.

activity_additions.name: Canifis–Mort'ton trapdoor shortcut
activity_additions.location: Trapdoor behind Hair of the Dog, Canifis → Mort'ton swamp boat area
requirements: In Search of the Myreque for base trapdoor / Myreque tunnel access
Temple Trekking: train Zachory Bragg to level 99 and toggle the shortcut reward on the noticeboard
unlocks: One-way Canifis trapdoor shortcut directly to Cyreg Paddlehorn / Mort'ton approach
Fast path from Canifis lodestone / bank into southern Morytania without full swamp traverse
Toggle on/off via Zachory's level 99 shortcut option on Temple Trekking noticeboards
activity_additions.notes: Base Myreque trapdoor already shortens Canifis→Hollows boat; Zachory 99 upgrades it to a direct Mort'ton dump. Distinct from Nature Grotto swamp-gate shortcut (total level 100). Complements games necklace Burgh teleport as alternate southern on-ramps.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania. Zachory 99 is the permanent toggle gate.

activity_additions.name: Ghast familiar (Temple Trekking)
activity_additions.location: Temple Trekking reward purchase after all companions 99
requirements: All six Temple Trekking companions trained to level 99
87 Summoning to summon
50,000 coins for a ghast pouch purchase (includes 25 Ghastly Request scrolls) — pouches cannot be player-crafted
unlocks: Ghast familiar (64 minutes, 10 summoning points): defensive familiar
Prevents food decay in Mort Myre Swamp and stops wild ghasts attacking in Morytania
Grants Prayer XP equal to 1% of familiar damage dealt
Ghastly Request special: restores 100 prayer points per scroll (20 special move points)
Thoroughly A-Ghast elite Morytania achievement by summoning the familiar in Morytania
activity_additions.notes: Only non-craftable combat-style familiar pouch besides meerkats. Complements ouroboros pouch: pouch handles auto-druid charges; familiar handles food-rot immunity and prayer restore while training. Do not treat as a general prayer-sustain meta over holy scarab for all content — Morytania-local utility is the point.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania Complete Trekky grind + 87 Summoning. Elite diary achievement is Morytania-local summon.
